inputContract.description: Supply model, prompt and creative params separately. Parameter alternatives depend on the real references; internal planning resolves the applicable contract. Defaults come from the active Web model settings and execution count policy. Explicit user choices take priority, then task-based host decisions; otherwise omit controls to use defaults. Existing nodes retain omitted settings. Do not select the highest option without a task reason. Recover accepted tasks with the original key and arguments, not new defaults. Do not copy raw schema/config/remoteExecution.
